name: Meta Advantage+ Shopping Campaign (ASC) Launch & Scale
purpose: Deploy and scale an automated high-converting Advantage+ Shopping campaign on Meta with catalog integration and creative diversity.
triggerConditions: Ecommerce store seeking automated Meta sales scale
Existing manual campaign hitting ad fatigue
prerequisites: Meta Ad Account connected with active payment method
Meta Pixel & CAPI healthy with event deduplication active
Product catalog synced or at least 5 creative assets ready

executionSteps.name: Validate Tracking Health
executionSteps.action: Verify Purchase event match quality score >= 8.0

executionSteps.name: Assemble Creative Blueprint
executionSteps.action: Select top 3 video hooks and 2 static product carousels

executionSteps.name: Construct Draft Campaign
executionSteps.action: Create Advantage+ Shopping Campaign draft with Target ROAS guardrail

executionSteps.name: Risk & Policy Assessment
executionSteps.action: Ensure ad text adheres to Meta Advertising Standards and daily budget is within safe limits

successCriteria: Campaign active with minimum 5 diverse creative assets
Learning phase exited with > 50 purchases in 7 days
ROAS meeting or exceeding industry template floor

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry campaign mutation once on transient graph API error

rollbackStrategy: Set campaign status to PAUSED immediately if first 24h spend exceeds $30 with zero conversions.
